description: Documentation-first framework for human-AI collaborative development with autonomous code generation, semantic memory, and TDD sandbox validation.

1_graph_rag_wikilinks.title: GraphRAG (Wikilink & Network Graph Traversal)
capabilities: 1-hop and 2-hop relational traversal with substantive content extraction
Token budget bounding (3500-4500 chars) safe for 8GB RAM laptops
Hybrid Seeding (Direct entity match + vector/TF-IDF similarity)
Prompt injection into blueprintApp architecture generator

2_continuous_learning_loop.title: Continuous Learning Loop (Obsidian Write-Back)
capabilities: AI-powered post-mortem generation via local model (qwen2.5-coder-1.5b)
Structured Markdown format with YAML frontmatter tags, aliases, and [[wikilinks]]
Dual trigger: TDD test failure detection + self-healing recovery from fatal crashes
Real-time incremental knowledge graph re-indexing after write
Training sample append to Google Colab CUDA dataset in '3 qwen/'

3_tiered_model_routing.title: Hierarchical / Tiered Model Routing

tiers.tier_0_heuristic: Zero-LLM instant heuristics, regex validator, static TDD assertions (< 1ms, 0 MB)
tiers.tier_1_fast_local: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B/3B (Q4_K_M) via node-llama-cpp on Vulkan/CPU for syntax fixes, classifications, TDD assertions (20-30 t/s, ~2.2 GB)
tiers.tier_2_deep_local: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B (Q4_K_M) via Ollama for multi-file architecture synthesis & Livewire component generation (12-16 t/s, ~4.8 GB)
tiers.tier_3_cloud_burst: Gemini 2.0 Flash REST API for massive 100-project batch scaffolding & complex graph reasoning (60-90 t/s, 0 MB RAM)

3_tiered_model_routing.routing_strategy: Task-complexity scoring (0-100) with automatic fallback cascading: Tier 0 -> Tier 1 -> Tier 2 -> Tier 3
verified_features: Instant Tier 0 heuristic execution for schema and code quality (< 1ms)
Automated complexity scoring mapping task types and prompt size to target tiers
Seamless graceful cascading fallback if higher tiers are unreachable

4_agentic_rag_hyde_crag.title: Agentic RAG dengan HyDE & Corrective RAG (CRAG)
completed_features: Hybrid Seeding (Direct Entity Match + TF-IDF/Vector Similarity)
Delta Indexing with mtime timestamp caching
Obsidian Vault + Local Memory dual-source indexing
Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE) zero-shot domain-specific code pattern expansion
Corrective RAG (CRAG) with confidence scoring threshold (>=0.60 DIRECT, 0.35-0.60 ENRICH_GRAPH_HYDE, <0.35 REFORMULATE_EXPAND)
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) combining Sparse TF-IDF, Dense nomic-embed-text, and Graph Wikilinks
